selection_history.statement: The marker panel was assembled after exploratory TCGA-TRACE triage. This registry does not claim prospective initial marker selection. It freezes the existing heterogeneous software stress-test panel before subsequent publication regeneration and revision.
selection_history.future_change_rule: A scenario may be added, removed or reclassified only in a new registry version with a written rationale. Observed effect direction, effect magnitude or p-value from a regeneration cannot trigger an in-place change.

scope.purpose: Software-behaviour benchmark, not biomarker discovery or clinical validation.
scope.primary_model: Continuous Cox effect per within-run score standard deviation, followed by a restricted cubic spline nonlinearity test.

endpoint_policy.default_rule: OS is the primary endpoint for cross-scenario comparability when it satisfies TCGA-CDR operational QC.
endpoint_policy.prespecified_exception: TCGA-UVM BAP1 uses DSS as its primary endpoint because the literature anchor concerns disease-specific metastatic prognosis in uveal melanoma. Current DSS analysis treats other-cause death as non-informative censoring.
endpoint_policy.sensitivity_rule: Additional endpoints are labelled endpoint sensitivities and cannot replace the registered primary endpoint because of a more favorable effect or p-value.
endpoint_policy.unavailable_endpoint_rule: A registered endpoint that fails operational QC remains a visible non-evaluable scenario; no outcome-driven endpoint substitution is allowed.

multiplicity_contract.continuous_linear_family: BH across all 11 registered marker-endpoint scenarios.
multiplicity_contract.continuous_nonlinearity_family: BH across all 11 registered spline-versus-linear tests.
multiplicity_contract.grouped_family: Holm across four grouped cutpoint rules within each registered marker-endpoint scenario.
multiplicity_contract.interpretation: Endpoint-sensitivity rows remain inside the full reported 11-test continuous families, but do not supersede the primary endpoint interpretation for their marker-cohort pair.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves a literature-guided hepatocellular carcinoma marker as an agreement case across continuous and grouped reporting layers.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered default primary endpoint and supports cross-scenario comparison.

literature_anchors.scope: CDC20-containing prognostic gene signature in hepatocellular carcinoma; the TCGA-TRACE single-gene assay and thresholds are not an exact replication.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves a literature-guided lung adenocarcinoma marker for quantifying how grouped estimates depend on cutpoint choice.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered default primary endpoint and matches the survival outcome emphasized by the literature anchor.

literature_anchors.scope: BIRC5 prognostic context in lung adenocarcinoma; the publication cohort and molecular restrictions are not reproduced by this all-eligible TCGA workflow.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves a disease-specific uveal melanoma marker while exposing sparse-event Cox behaviour, events-per-parameter warnings and Firth sensitivity.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: DSS is the sole prespecified exception to the default OS rule because BAP1 is anchored to metastatic and disease-specific prognosis in uveal melanoma.

literature_anchors.scope: BAP1 expression and uveal melanoma prognostic parameters; RNA abundance does not reproduce immunohistochemical classification.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves a strong literature-guided association whose marker-specific proportional-hazards caution tests whether the interface separates effect estimation from model diagnostics.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered default primary endpoint. Generic clinical adjustment does not replace LGG molecular subtype adjustment.

literature_anchors.scope: EMP3 appears in a lower-grade glioma prognostic analysis; TCGA-TRACE does not claim independence from IDH or 1p/19q status.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves a canonical clear-cell renal carcinoma marker for nonlinear continuous modelling and comparison with an external survival resource.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered default primary endpoint and is available in both TCGA-TRACE and the external comparison.

literature_anchors.scope: CA9 biology and debated prognostic value in clear-cell renal carcinoma; RNA abundance is not equivalent to immunohistochemical CA9.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves a familiar proliferation marker as the primary endpoint reference for an explicit OS-versus-PFI sensitivity pair.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered primary endpoint. PFI is evaluated only in the linked sensitivity row.

literature_anchors.scope: Ki-67 protein cutpoint meta-analysis for breast cancer OS and disease-free outcomes; MKI67 RNA abundance and TCGA cutpoints are not equivalent assays.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Tests whether the reporting profile changes under a progression-like TCGA-CDR endpoint without replacing the registered OS interpretation.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: PFI is a prespecified sensitivity paired with the MKI67 OS primary scenario and cannot become primary because of its observed result.

literature_anchors.scope: The literature reports OS and disease-free outcomes, motivating an endpoint sensitivity while not equating PFI with study-specific DFS.
TCGA-CDR definition and harmonization of PFI.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves an immune-checkpoint marker for testing prognostic direction and the explicit primary-versus-metastatic sample-composition sensitivity.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered default primary endpoint and matches the cited pan-cancer SKCM analysis.

literature_anchors.scope: Pan-cancer PDCD1 expression analysis reporting SKCM OS and DSS associations; TCGA reuse makes this a software stress test, not external validation.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves an exploratory immune-regulatory marker with biological and SKCM prognostic literature while keeping biological validation outside the benchmark claim.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered default primary endpoint and matches the SKCM prognostic literature.

literature_anchors.scope: SKCM prognostic and immune-infiltration context; the TCGA-derived component is not independent validation.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Preserves a clinically familiar immune-checkpoint marker whose unsupported or weak TCGA-TRACE result remains visible rather than being removed after exploratory triage.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered primary endpoint and matches the literature's primary survival outcome. PFI is evaluated only as a linked sensitivity.

literature_anchors.scope: PD-L1 protein and transcript prognostic meta-analysis in resected lung adenocarcinoma; TCGA-TRACE CD274 RNA does not replicate protein thresholds or treatment context.

scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Tests whether the CD274 reporting profile changes under a progression-like endpoint while preserving an unsupported result if the sensitivity is also null.
scenarios.endpoint_rationale: PFI is a prespecified sensitivity paired with the CD274 OS primary scenario and cannot supersede OS because of its observed result.

literature_anchors.scope: The literature includes disease-free outcomes, motivating but not equating the TCGA-CDR PFI sensitivity.
TCGA-CDR definition and harmonization of PFI.
